about_the_game:
Tainted Grail: The Fall of Avalon – Supporters Pack

This special DLC is for all of you who want to support the game and our journey as independent developers. It includes:

🎵 Original Soundtrack (MP3) – a complete selection of haunting, atmospheric tracks from the game, composed to immerse you in the unsettling and mysterious world of Avalon.

📘 Digital Artbook (PDF) – featuring dozens of pages of concept art, illustrations, and behind-the-scenes materials that reveal the visual soul of the game’s design.

All content will be available in the game’s installation folder after purchase.

Thank you for supporting Tainted Grail: The Fall of Avalon – it means the world to us! 💛

content_descriptors.notes:
Tainted Grail: The Fall of Avalon contains mature themes and content that may not be appropriate for all audiences.

This includes:
- Violence and combat involving blood, dismemberment, and realistic weapon use
- Dark fantasy themes, including death, decay, and morally ambiguous choices
- Occasional strong language and emotionally intense dialogue
- References to mental instability, despair, and sacrifice
- Alcohol consumption and suggestive content in dialogue

The game explores a corrupted, mythological world filled with hopelessness, survival, and moral grey areas. Player discretion is advised.
